definition: A worksheet used by noncorporate taxpayers to calculate passive activity losses and determine the amount of losses that can be deducted in the current tax year versus those that must be carried forward to future years.

includes.text: Contains parts for combining net income and losses from passive activities
includes.quote: Use Part I to combine the net income and net loss from all passive activities

includes.text: Includes sections for rental real estate activities with active participation
includes.quote: Use Part IV for rental real estate activities with active participation

includes.text: Contains calculation of modified adjusted gross income for special allowance determination
includes.quote: To figure modified adjusted gross income

excludes.text: Does not report business income of a sole proprietor
excludes.quote: Trade or business activities are generally reported on Schedule C

excludes.text: Does not report capital gains and losses from investment property dispositions
excludes.quote: Capital losses that are allowable under the passive loss rules may be limited under the capital loss limitations

excludes.text: Does not report corporate passive activity losses
excludes.quote: Corporations subject to the passive activity rules must use Form 8810

discriminators.text: Allocates passive activity losses among multiple activities and carries forward disallowed losses; a sibling reports business income of one self-employed individual with no loss limitation carryforward mechanism
discriminators.quote: PALs not allowed in the current year are carried forward until they're allowed

discriminators.text: Limits passive activity losses based on passive income and special allowances; that schedule reports capital gains and losses without this document
discriminators.quote: PALs can't be used to offset income from nonpassive activities

discriminators.text: Applies this document to individual taxpayers; corporate income tax returns do not use this document
discriminators.quote: Form 8582 is used by noncorporate taxpayers to figure the amount of any passive activity loss
